<function name="OpenURL" parent="gui" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Opens specified URL in the steam overlay browser.

<note>When called clientside, user will be asked for confirmation before the website will open.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="url" type="string">URL to open, it has to start with either `http://` or `https://`.</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Opens a page when a button is clicked.</description>
	<code>
local button = vgui.Create( "DButton" )
button:SetSize( 125, 90 )
button:Center() 
button:SetText( "Join our Discord!" )
button.DoClick = function()
    gui.OpenURL( "https://discord.gg/gmod" )
end
	</code>

</example>
